name: Karen Goldschlager
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: I am a telehealth based psychologist dedicated to helping adults to heal trauma and cultivate personal power. Using EMDR, ACT, and a neuro-affirming lens, I provide a warm and trauma informed space, focused on safety, transparency, and collaboration.
specialties: Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse sexualities, EMDR

name: Madeline Gibson
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: I am a registered psychologist and neuropsychology registrar with a particular interest in understanding how cognition, neurodiversity, mental health and everyday life intersect. I work with adolescents and adults for therapy and cognitive assessments. Drawing on ACT, CBT and Schema Therapy, alongside principles from Buddhist psychology, I support people to manage distress and everyday challenges, develop practical ways of coping, and navigate periods of uncertainty, adjustment and change.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Diverse genders, Schema Therapy

name: Raissa Donadon Berne
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Therapy with Raissa goes beyond symptom management. She creates the space to process the pain that exists as a part of the human condition, respond to life’s challenges with greater flexibility and resilience, and build a more grounded, compassionate relationship with yourself and the people around you.

name: Carlye Crank
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
address: 254 Bay Road Sandringham, Within Blue Ocean Counselling
description: A real person first, clinical psychologist second. I like to think I'm genuine and easy to talk to, seeing a whole person in front of me and not just symptoms or labels. Although I see people with most mental health issues including worry, anxiety and depression, I have an additional interest in working with: trauma, stress, major life events and transitions; adolescents and young adults; Interpersonal/ relationship issues; chronic health conditions; postpartum depression, anxiety and OCD. I am trained in a variety of evidence-based techniques including CBT, ACT, trauma-informed approaches, EMDR, DBT, Expressive Arts and Schema Therapy and use a tailored approach to work with clients to build on strengths and live more fulfilling lives.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Kaileen Pearson
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
address: 1156 Main Rd, Mullum Road Clinic Eltham
description: I am an experienced psychologist, having worked with adults, teens, children, couples, and families for 30 years. The issues we've addressed include depression, anxiety, stress, conflict, trauma, grief, work/school problems, health, relationships and sex therapy etc. Some patients had elements of autism or ADHD (Neuro-diverse - ND or were gender diverse), all of which can bring strengths and challenges.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual difficulties, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders

name: Leah Macklan
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Bachelor of Social Science Majoring in Psychology and Sociology, Postgraduate Diploma of Psychology and Master of Counselling Psychology Leah is a warm and engaging psychologist who believes it is integral to form a trusting and authentic connection with her clients, to be able to truly understand their world and implement change. Leah assists clients to set goals specific to their needs and tailors psychological interventions based on their existing skill-set of strategies. Leah is proudly an ally to the LGBTQI+ community and works with young people and adults from 12 years onward.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria

name: Angela Maria Hernandez Saa
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: I work with adults and teenagers experiencing trauma, anxiety, ADHD, depression, and major life transitions. Many clients come to therapy feeling overwhelmed or stuck in patterns they would like to understand and change. My approach integrates trauma-informed therapy, EMDR with an attachment focus, parts work, and somatic practices to support emotional processing, nervous system regulation, and deeper self-understanding. I provide an inclusive, LGBTQIA+ affirming and culturally responsive space where clients can move toward greater stability, self-compassion, and meaningful change. I offer a compassionate, trauma-informed approach that combines EMDR with an attachment focus, parts work, and somatic practices.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, EMDR
